statusNote: Proposed. D1-D5 must be approved and recorded in decisions.md before any token is issued with these scopes. See Appendix A callout.

responseBoundary.note: D4. v1 defines scopes as endpoint-family permissions, not strict data-family isolation. Quran verse endpoints may still embed translations/tafsirs/audio, and content sync snapshots may return full resources across content types. Strict isolation requires a different, field-aware design and a revised migration equivalence; it is not activated by this contract.

scopes.description: Reciters, recitations, audio files, timing/lookup, recitation information and styles.
Chapters, structure, pages, verses and scripts.
Hadith references, text and range counts.
Translation catalogs, information, verse translations and footnotes.
Languages and verse media. Distinct from, and much narrower than, content.sync.read.
Public content delta sync and resource snapshots. NOT the existing user-data 'sync' scope.
The five public QuranReflect reads only. Grants no private posts, my-posts, private rooms, user-specific feeds, mutations or moderation.
Answers by ayah, answer detail and range counts.

legacyScopes.note: Umbrella. Remains broad after migration: removing one granular successor does not narrow a client that still holds it. Retirement is a separate, unscheduled project with no assumed sunset date.
Legacy read alternative. Continues to authorize every previously covered read.

c8Rule.note: A content.create-only client has no intersection and therefore gains no read successors.

reflectionsRule.note: Eligible only when the client's scopes intersect the legacyAnyOf of ALL five public reflection routes. Narrow clients therefore need post.read AND comment.read. A client holding only the 'post' umbrella does satisfy this, because 'post' is an accepted alternative on all five routes today. 'content' alone never satisfies it.

equivalentSuccessors.$comment: A' = A union equivalentSuccessors_v1(A). Finite and approved; never 'every scope starting with content.'

$comment: D5. Replaces only the legacy content-read component of the existing environment baseline.
Unrelated pre-existing baseline entries are retained verbatim by the Platform policy code;
this contract does not enumerate them and must not be used to widen them.
Inspected production baseline already includes post.read and comment.read alongside
Revalidate on the implementation branch before activation.

quotaPolicy.note: A5. Quota buckets are snapshotted from today's behavior and are deliberately NOT the authorization alternatives. Today checkRateLimit() iterates the matched scope list, so adding granular scopes to authorization would silently add new buckets and could split or double-charge an aggregate allowance. quotaBuckets freezes the pre-migration bucket set. Source: src/libs/rate-limit.ts :: checkRateLimit (plus the always-charged global '' bucket).
